_comment: TODO: placeholder target. Coordinates use the same convention as structure_schema.json, in the CAMERA's frame (x = left to right as the robot sees it, y = front (nearest robot) to back, layer 0 = on the table). (x, y) is the block's stud with the smallest x and smallest y. orientation 0 = long side along x, 90 = long side along y; 2x2 is always 0. front_visible = false for blocks the camera cannot see in the finished build: they are reported but not required for a full match.
